title: pvSynchronizeTime
body:
## pvSynchronizeTime

Snaps the time values of one dataset to those of another. DataToPass supplies the data and its time steps; any of its time values within RelativeTolerance × (its time range) of a TimeToSync time value is replaced by that value, so both sources report identical times, e.g. a simulation written at 0.1000001 s and experimental data at 0.1 s. The output keeps DataToPass's data and number of time steps; only the time labels change.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Data are not interpolated in time; for different sampling use a temporal interpolator.
- Two input steps that snap to the same value become ambiguous; ParaView warns about this.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `SynchronizeTime`. Identity: `filters/SynchronizeTime`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DataToPass` | Required data input for the native DataToPass port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the dataset whose geometry and fields will be output. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); composite data (multiblock or partitioned collections) (vtkCompositeDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkCompositeDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
| `TimeToSync` | Required data input for the native TimeToSync port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the dataset from which to obtain the time step values. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); composite data (multiblock or partitioned collections) (vtkCompositeDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkCompositeDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `RelativeTolerance` | Fraction of the DataToPass time range within which a DataToPass time value is replaced by a TimeToSync time value: the absolute threshold is RelativeTolerance × (last time − first time). Larger values snap more distant times; 0 snaps nothing. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvSynchronizeTime",
  "inputs": {
    "DataToPass": "UPSTREAM_DataToPass",
    "TimeToSync": "UPSTREAM_TimeToSync"
  }
}
```
